forward_accounting_scope: Whole tiny Transformer calls; coefficient, theory and precompute submodules excluded

result.collinear_interpretation: Matches analytic identity-prior ridge bias; not mathematically zero for nonunit scale

result.missing_variance: Statistics must supply mean and variance
result.negative_variance: Variance statistics must be nonnegative population variances
result.unsupported_shift_mode: Channel correction mode must be none or affine
result.uninitialized_anchor: Channel correction requires initialized real cache timestamps
result.mode_changed_mid_request: Changing correction mode during a request requires begin
result.zero_cond_t: Channel pilot requires ordinary timestep conditioning
result.wrong_schedule_length: Channel pilot requires eight finite fixed scheduler timesteps
result.missing_tables: prepare_tables must complete before enabling Value correction

default_metadata.timestep_conversion: Cast scheduler timestep to model dtype, then divide by 1000, matching pipeline input
default_metadata.objective: Diagonal-covariance frozen-centered-feature MSE plus lambda_s*(a-1)^2 for each output channel
default_metadata.rho_definition: Square root of summed predicted centered Value residual variance divided by summed target variance; surrogate diagnostic only
default_metadata.schedule_contract: Reuse only with identical frozen fused weights, dtype, device, statistics and exact eight model timesteps; caller verifies scheduler
default_metadata.inference_cost: No extra token projection; eager per-token channel coefficient gathers add bandwidth and temporary memory
default_metadata.interpretation: Per-output-channel attention Value approximation; does not recover hidden drift, stale K or general cross-channel covariance; no quality claim
default_metadata.provenance_responsibility: Caller supplies and verifies source hashes, calibration-only data and image-level split
default_metadata.statistic_semantics: Target img_norm1 output before modulation; population variance, not post-modulation features
default_metadata.timestep_statistics_semantics: For pair (t,s), the same frozen h=mean_s+xi_s is used at both timesteps with diagonal Var(xi_s)=variance_s; anchor mean and variance only
